## Summary
Lenses checked: correctness, silent-failure, tests, comments.

The optional JSON destination should be fixed because it consumes a following option as a filename, breaking combined JSON and JUnit output.

## Critical
(none)

## Important
- app/cli.py:15 — correctness — `parse_args(["--json", "--junit", "out.xml"])` raises `ValueError("unknown option: out.xml")` instead of selecting both reports. The JSON branch treats every following token as its destination and consumes `--junit`. Consume the next token only when it is a path, otherwise retain `results.json`, and add coverage for this combined invocation. — Users cannot place a default-destination `--json` before `--junit out.xml`; report generation fails.

(none)

## Strengths
- The explicit JSON destination test verifies written file contents.
- Tests preserve rejection of missing JUnit paths, including when another option follows.
